title: AWS ECS (terraform-aws-modules/ecs/aws)
description: Provision an ECS cluster, task definition and service via ACK ecs. Input names mirror the terraform-aws-modules/ecs/aws module (a curated CORE subset of its inputs: cluster-level inputs plus the per-service inputs from the module's `services` map, flattened for a single service).

region.title: AWS region
region.description: AWS region for the ECS cluster, task definition and service. Krateo/ACK wiring (not a Terraform module input). Empty inherits the ACK controller default.

cluster_name.title: cluster_name
cluster_name.description: Name of the cluster (up to 255 letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores).

cluster_setting.title: cluster_setting
cluster_setting.description: List of configuration block(s) with cluster settings. For example, this can be used to enable CloudWatch Container Insights for a cluster.

default_capacity_provider_strategy.title: default_capacity_provider_strategy
default_capacity_provider_strategy.description: Map of default capacity provider strategy definitions to use for the cluster. Keyed by capacity provider name; each entry sets base/weight.

cluster_capacity_providers.title: cluster_capacity_providers
cluster_capacity_providers.description: List of short names of one or more capacity providers to associate with the cluster (e.g. FARGATE, FARGATE_SPOT).

family.title: family
family.description: A unique name for the task definition (the `services.<name>.family` input in the module).

container_name.title: container_name
container_name.description: Name of the container as it appears in the task definition (the `services.<name>.container_name` input).

image.title: image
image.description: The image used to start the container (the `services.<name>.container_definitions.*.image` input).

container_port.title: container_port
container_port.description: Port on the container to associate with the service / port mapping (the `services.<name>.container_port` input).

cpu.title: cpu
cpu.description: Number of CPU units used by the task, expressed as a string (the `services.<name>.cpu` input). e.g. "256".

memory.title: memory
memory.description: Amount (in MiB) of memory used by the task, expressed as a string (the `services.<name>.memory` input). e.g. "512".

network_mode.title: network_mode
network_mode.description: Docker networking mode to use for the containers in the task (the `services.<name>.network_mode` input).

requires_compatibilities.title: requires_compatibilities
requires_compatibilities.description: Set of launch types required by the task (the `services.<name>.requires_compatibilities` input). e.g. ["FARGATE"].

task_exec_iam_role_arn.title: task_exec_iam_role_arn
task_exec_iam_role_arn.description: Existing IAM role ARN for the task execution role (the `services.<name>.task_exec_iam_role_arn` input). Passed through to the ACK TaskDefinition `executionRoleARN`; this stack does NOT create IAM roles.

tasks_iam_role_arn.title: tasks_iam_role_arn
tasks_iam_role_arn.description: Existing IAM role ARN for the task role (the `services.<name>.tasks_iam_role_arn` input). Passed through to the ACK TaskDefinition `taskRoleARN`; this stack does NOT create IAM roles.

desired_count.title: desired_count
desired_count.description: Number of instances of the task definition to place and keep running (the `services.<name>.desired_count` input).

launch_type.title: launch_type
launch_type.description: Launch type on which to run the service (the `services.<name>.launch_type` input).

platform_version.title: platform_version
platform_version.description: Platform version on which to run the service, for the FARGATE launch type (the `services.<name>.platform_version` input).

scheduling_strategy.title: scheduling_strategy
scheduling_strategy.description: Scheduling strategy to use for the service (the `services.<name>.scheduling_strategy` input).

assign_public_ip.title: assign_public_ip
assign_public_ip.description: Assign a public IP address to the ENI of the service tasks (the `services.<name>.assign_public_ip` input). Only used with `awsvpc` network mode.

subnet_ids.title: subnet_ids
subnet_ids.description: List of EXISTING subnet IDs associated with the service task ENIs (the `services.<name>.subnet_ids` input). Passed through to the ACK Service `networkConfiguration.awsVPCConfiguration.subnets`; this stack does NOT create subnets.

security_group_ids.title: security_group_ids
security_group_ids.description: List of EXISTING security group IDs associated with the service task ENIs (the `services.<name>.security_group_ids` input). Passed through to the ACK Service `networkConfiguration.awsVPCConfiguration.securityGroups`; this stack does NOT create security groups.

enable_execute_command.title: enable_execute_command
enable_execute_command.description: Whether the execute command functionality is turned on for the service (the `services.<name>.enable_execute_command` input).

enable_ecs_managed_tags.title: enable_ecs_managed_tags
enable_ecs_managed_tags.description: Whether to turn on Amazon ECS managed tags for the tasks within the service (the `services.<name>.enable_ecs_managed_tags` input).

tags.title: tags
tags.description: A map of tags to add to all resources.

cluster_tags.title: cluster_tags
cluster_tags.description: A map of additional tags to add to the cluster.

service_tags.title: service_tags
service_tags.description: A map of additional tags to add to the service (the `services.<name>.service_tags` input).
